lugs.title: Find stranded ideas in old tracks and offer them as backlog candidates

attempts.summary: Added tools/stranded_ideas.py (read-only: lists open, non-intentional ideas from each track's last open list with file:line) plus tests/stranded_ideas.sh proving output and no writes
attempts.evidence: I read tools/stranded_ideas.py. It only opens files in read mode, uses json and sys, and prints to stdout. It sets sys.dont_write_bytecode and has no write, open-for-write, or subprocess calls. Running `python3 -B tools/stranded_ideas.py` on the three sample tracks printed 5 open ideas, each as `sam
